text:
sam: hey folks, hi i'm sam, starting oncall next week. couple oddball Qs before my first shift: is there a preferred way to run a pager test via the web UI (i'm less comfy with curl), who is my shadow for week 1, and do we have a tiny runbook for query-timeout incidents?
viv: welcome sam! i'm your week-1 shadow. add me on PagerDuty (viv@redwood.com). for the UI test open PD -> Services -> ops-sim -> Trigger an incident -> choose test user. that will send the same simulation as the curl.
owen: added sam to the oncall calendar and shadow rota. Query-timeout runbook is at https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/oncall/query-timeout. TL;DR: 1) Identify query path and recent deploys 2) check replica lag 3) scale read pool if needed 4) failover per runbook.
sam: tried the UI test but didn't see an alert on my phone. PD shows "triggered" though.
kate: two quick checks: 1) confirm push notifications enabled in PD mobile profile 2) confirm PD contact method ordering (push first, then SMS). Also check your device has background app refresh enabled.
sam: push enabled, background refresh on, still nothing. PD web shows alert acknowledged by system "ops-sim" already.
viv: odd. can you open PD incident and click "notify user"? sometimes the mobile push service drops; fallback should be SMS. also check if your phone carrier blocks some push traffic — rare but has happened.
opsbot: OpsBot: For programmatic test: curl -X POST https://ops-api.redwood.internal/triggersim -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" -d '{"user":"sam","kind":"ui-or-curl"}'. If you get 401/403 see https://docs.redwood.com/oncall/access-troubleshoot.
sam: used opsbot curl now and got 200. push arrived on my phone. Looks like the UI trigger is fine but mobile push service had a transient hiccup.
owen: sweet. other oddball: who to escalate for long-running query timeouts vs full DB outage?
kate: query timeouts -> page db-oncall first. Full DB outage -> page infra + db-oncall immediately, and after 10m escalate to eng-sre. Ack windows: 5m P1 day, 10m night/weekend.
sam: thanks. last Q: are there recordings or a checklist of what the shadow will do during a first incident? want to know what to expect.
viv: yes, we have a 12-min video walkthrough and a 1-page checklist. i'll DM you both links. checklist includes: 1) join incident Zoom 2) confirm impact and scope 3) follow runbook mitigations 4) update slack incident thread every 10m 5) postmortem owner assignment.
opsbot: OpsBot: Test log 1849007777 - delivered via push to sam; status: delivered; ack: none.
sam: awesome, appreciate everyone — i'll watch the video and do the UI test again before my week. Feeling better! :thumbsup:
